jobs.title: Confirmed FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your Mission
We are looking for a FP&A Analyst to join the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team at BlaBlaCar, whose mission is to structure, analyze, forecast and monitor BlaBlaCar’s activity and financial results. 
Reporting to the FP&A Manager, in a multicultural team of 11, your role will be to act as a link between finance and business. Your primary role will involve providing a financial business partnering to the Engineering department, responsible for developing our platform. You will also take part in supporting different commercial business units (incl. Carpooling, Bus Marketplace and Train) and Product & Marketing department.

Your responsibilities 

Forecasting, budgeting and financial analysis of Engineering, Product & Growth departments,
Presentation of financial results to the management,
Development and maintenance of reports related to the commercial scope (Carpooling, Bus Marketplace, Train),
Support the monthly reporting process, acting as a coordinator within FP&A and with Accounting teams to ensure reporting timelines are respected and presentations updated in a timely manner,
Reviewing, approving and controlling the costs, ensuring high financial discipline,
Reviewing and approving contracts signed by Engineering department, to ensure that financial terms are favorable, 
Controlling personnel costs in assigned scope,
Prepare ad hoc analyses and reports.


Your qualifications 

Bachelor or master degree in finance, economics, econometrics or similar discipline,
Previous finance experience (at least 1-2 years), FP&A experience strongly preferred,
An analytical mindset, 
Strong business acumen,
Strong communication skills,
You are eager to understand financial processes to collect and analyze data,
Willingness to learn,
Full working proficiency in English, advanced French strongly preferred,
Nice to have: experience in a tech company, experience with a reporting tool (Pigment, TM1, Anaplan…), BI tool (Power BI, Tableau).
 What we have to offer

Hybrid position : 2 days at the office per week 
50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
Financial support for home office equipment
Minimum 25 days holiday per year 
Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs
Employee Stock ownership plan
Regular team building events
1 day off per year to test our product
Interested in joining the ride?
PLEASE UPLOAD YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH !

a 45-min video-call with your Talent Acquisition Manager to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions
a case study to assess your financial analysis skills followed by a 60-min interview with our FP&A Manager Patryk Korycki to discuss the case study, your interest in the role and your career expectations
A 30-min chat with team members: Charles and Jessica,
a 30-min interview with Candice François, Head of SFBA to check team fit
 
Our hiring process lasts on average 25-30 days, offers usually come within 48 hours.

BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: (Freelance) - Compensation & Benefits Specialist
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


We are looking for a Compensation & Benefits Specialist with 5+ years of hands-on experience for an immediate, 3-month contract to reinforce our People team through a critical phase of the annual compensation calendar. This is a fully hands-on mission with real ownership from day one: you'll need to be operational within days, not weeks, picking up live, time-sensitive workstreams already in motion.
You will report directly to the Head of Talent, Culture & Performance and partner closely with HRBPs and local HR teams to keep BlaBlaCar's core compensation processes running without disruption.

Your responsibilities
Budget 2027 Own the finalization and consolidation of the 2027 C&B budget, including benefits cost simulations, across BlaBlaCar's scope.

NAO (Négociations Annuelles Obligatoires) Lead the preparation of the NAO process for France: equity and gender pay gap data, compensation thresholds, market survey inputs, and negotiation-ready materials for the CSE.

EOY Compensation Review Drive the global End-of-Year compensation review process end-to-end: calibration follow-up, salary review campaign execution, consolidation, reporting, and day-to-day support to HRBPs and managers.

Salary Bands & Job Architecture Update and maintain salary bands and the grading system across departments and geographies — including finalizing bands for Brazil and Ukraine — grounded in external benchmarks (AON Radford, Ravio).
Your qualifications
Required

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Compensation & Benefits, in an international environment

- Proven experience owning an End-of-Year compensation review cycle end-to-end

- Experience preparing and running NAO processes in a French context

- Strong expertise in job architecture, salary band design, and market benchmarking (Mercer, AON Radford, Ravio or equivalent)

- Comfortable joining a live, ongoing cycle with minimal ramp-up time

- Full professional proficiency in English and French

- Available immediately for a 3-month engagement (freelance/contractor or via agency)

Nice to Have

- Prior experience with Ravio or similar compensation intelligence tools

- Experience in a Tech scale-up or multi-country, multi-collective-agreement C&B scope
Interested in joining the ride?
Given the urgency of this mission, the process is fast-tracked: a single screening call with Pierre , Head of Talent, Culture & Performance, followed by a quick decision.

jobs.title: Compensation & Benefits Specialist
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


We are looking for a Compensation & Benefits Specialist with 5+ years of hands-on experience to support, evolve and operate our global C&B programs. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, sitting at the intersection of rigorous analysis and day-to-day operational delivery, mixing 60% run 40% projects.
You will be the C&B specialist of the People team, reporting directly to the Head of Talent, Culture & Performance. You will partner closely with the DRH, the Remuneration Committee, People Ops, and local HR teams to ensure BlaBlaCar's compensation programs are competitive, equitable and compliant — and ready for the EU Pay Transparency Directive (effective 2027).
The role covers the full C&B spectrum across BlaBlaCar's international footprint (France, Brazil, Poland, Ukraine, Spain and beyond): base salary architecture, variable compensation, equity programs (AGA / BSPCE / O-shares / M-shares), employee savings (PEE/PERCO, intéressement), and benefits.

Your responsibilities
- Participate in designing, then implementing and managing the Compensation & Benefits strategy across BlaBlaCar

- Update and maintain BlaBlaCar's salary grid and grading system (L1–L7) per job function, ensuring it remains grounded on relevant external surveys and benchmarks (AON Radford / Ravio)

- Review and enhance variable compensation programs, leave & benefits across all geographies (France, Brazil, Poland, Ukraine, Spain)

- Participate in budget creation and follow-up its consumption

- Lead the annual End-of-Year compensation review process globally

- Prepare meetings, minutes, presentations and data for the Remuneration Committee (RemCo)

At BlaBlaCar, this also means:

- Supporting the administration of all equity programs (O-shares, M-shares, AGA, BSPCE): contributing to pool design and grant calibration under the Head of TCP's oversight, applying vesting rules and reconciling the Comuto transaction ledger

- Configuring and operating the Workday Advanced Compensation module: salary ranges, cycle setup, reporting and dashboards

- Contributing to pay transparency readiness ahead of the EU Directive (2027): conducting pay equity analyses and supporting compliance mapping and the remediation roadmap

- Overseeing employee savings programs (PEE/PERCO, intéressement) and the international C&B policy roadmap
Your qualifications
Required

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Compensation & Benefits, in an international environment

- Strong expertise in job architecture, salary range design and market benchmarking (AON Radford, Mercer, Ravio or equivalent)

- Experience with EU Pay Transparency Directive readiness or pay equity analysis

- Experience supporting equity programs (AGA, BSPCE, RSU or equivalent), including grant cycle administration

- Solid command of French C&B regulatory frameworks: AGA/BSPCE, intéressement, PEE/PERCO, working time compliance

- Advanced analytical skills — comfortable managing large datasets; experience with Workday Advanced Compensation strongly preferred

- Demonstrated experience in a Tech scale-up or company with multi-sites, multi-country and/or multi-collective agreements C&B scope

- Rigorous and comfortable preparing materials and contributing to discussions with senior stakeholders (RemCo, DRH, ExCo)

- Full professional proficiency in English and French

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with Workday-to-benchmark API integrations or HRIS automation projects

- Prior experience with Ravio, Pigment or similar compensation intelligence tools
What we have to offer
- Hybrid set-up (2- 3 days per week at the office)

- 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

- 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

- Financial support for home office equipment

- Minimum 25 days holiday per year

- Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

- 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

- Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

- Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility opportunities

- Employee Stock ownership plan

- Regular team building events

- 1 day off per year to test our product
Interested in joining the ride?
- a 45-min video-call with Elodie, TA Team Lead, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

- a 60-min video-call with Pierre , Head of Talent, Culture & Performance, to discuss your experience and share more details about the position

- a 90-min case study with our People Team

- a 30-min video-call with Frédéric , CHRO, for vision fit and rounding off the process
BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
